name: quadmail
description: Your own email server and webmail on Cloudflare's free plan, with Resend for sending.

scripts.deploy: node scripts/deploy-guard.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && vite build && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:quadgentics: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env quadgentics && vite build --mode quadgentics && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.db:migrate:quadgentics:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env quadgentics
scripts.db:migrate:quadgentics: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env quadgentics

SETUP_CODE.description: Any phrase of **8 or more characters** that only you know. The setup wizard on your new QuadMail asks for it, so nobody else can claim the installation first.

DB.description: Mail metadata, users and settings (D1, created for you).

MAIL.description: Raw mail and attachments (R2, created for you).
